links.outcome: Translation factual correctness and harmful errors stratified by target language
links.effect: Factual correctness averaged 79%, English 84% and French 83% versus Russian 69% (each p<0.05). Potentially harmful errors in 4% of translations, primarily Russian (9%).
links.quote: Factual correctness averaged 79 %, with English (84 %) and French (83 %) outperforming Russian (69 %) (each p < 0.05).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of GPT-4o's capability to translate radiology reports into multiple languages, assessed by bilingual radiologists without comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
